### Context ###
- `_resolve_pid_from_payload` tries each `(source, field)` pair of `_PID_DISPATCH` in order; the first non-`None`
  float wins. So a `None` from the `obd` source falls through to the `ff` source by design.
- `composition._run_obdlab` copies `trim_analytics_gate` into COMLab's payload as a `TrimAnalyticsGate`; the shim reads
  `obd_live_data` as a dict.
- OBDLab computes the gate in `AnalyticsPreconditions.evaluate` and leaves `shrtft1`/`longft1` unchanged when it blocks.
